name: citybus-live
description: Live bus tracking for Coimbatore — GTFS + GTFS-Realtime transit platform

scripts.dev: npm run build:gtfs && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:gtfs && npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspace @citybus/web && npm run build --workspace @citybus/server
